goal: Produce actual first new 4-character wordmark 雾起长桥 with two equally budgeted graphical generator arms, and assess whole-word coherent art style rather than single-stroke edits.
charset: Chinese simplified exactly four Hanzi; forbid anything else
source_evidence: Liang Zhijian 2019 放肆喜欢/海棠未雨 creator process via available full reprint; methods only, no traced outlines

A.task: Neutral comparator in a single row of four exact characters, like an uncustomized but elegantly typeset Chinese serif wordmark, professional legibility, unmodified conventional characters, neutral ink, no graphic effects.
A.frozen_instructions: 独立透明背景中文字标，只出现准确简体『雾起长桥』四个字，单行横排，黑色中性端正规范宋体字型，基准排版，四字大小、字重基本统一，间距规整，保持标准汉字结构和可读性；不得添加书法变形、断笔、飞白、插画、符号、更多字、边框、背景。请只产出整组字标的PNG。

B.task: Designer-program arm: custom four-character wordmark as one coherent whole, not changed per-glyph geometry for its own sake, legible first. Need conditional visual signature and rhythm shared across sparse and dense forms.
B.frozen_instructions: 独立透明背景中文字标，只出现准确简体『雾起长桥』四个字，单行横排，深墨黑、无图案。核心是字组设计，不是给四字简单套同一字体：整体克制流动、略带古典气质；『雾』笔画复杂应减轻拥挤并保留内部白口；『起』左边结构密但右『己』保留大负形与一条有辨识度的收笔；『长』简洁但应有醒目的长方向主笔以平衡整体重量；『桥』左右木与乔的间隙清楚，选择一条结构内伸笔与『长』的主笔节奏呼应。四字保持正确汉字识别，粗细光学均衡，笔势有一套视觉语法但每字处理不同；无任何绘图道具、插画、背景、渐变、纹理、边框、文字注释或额外字符。仅产出字标PNG。

generator_equal_budget.executor: ChatGPT native image_gen with same available model, one invocation n=1 for A, one invocation n=1 for B
generator_equal_budget.post_generation_processing: Exact unchanged pixels for actual evaluation; any optional display crop must be equal/comparable and disclosed
generator_equal_budget.supplemental_manual_vector_rule: If full sentence fails text gate, any subsequent clean SVG recreation must be labeled a distinct remediation/not included in equal-budget A/B validation.
generator_equal_budget.execution_sequence: A then B; each at most one actual generated output, preserve failures.

verify.image_exact_four_hanzi: manual visual and independent checks if available; never infer from prompt
verify.transparent_alpha: read actual PNG alpha; if absent report
verify.negative_space_and_weight: qualitative visual review and small-size preview
verify.source_in_git: GitHub text/hash metadata only; actual PNG bytes archived in conversation user bundle

rule_promotion: Fail closed unless all text, actual pixel, style-coherence and independently validated aesthetic/multiword transfer gates succeed.
